name: Camera
tagline: Photos, clips and codes from this computer's cameras

offers.label: Record scan
offers.description: Keeps a scanned code in the history; the same code seen again moves to the front rather than

offers.label: Set grid
offers.description: Shows the composition grid, or takes it away.

offers.label: Set level
offers.description: Shows the level guide, or takes it away.

offers.label: Prefs of
offers.description: The person's preferences, made the first time they are written.

offers.label: Session of
offers.description: The person's document, made the first time it is written.

offers.label: Use mode
offers.description: Opens the viewfinder.

offers.label: Cycle lens
offers.description: Switches to the next lens.

offers.label: Use camera
offers.description: Uses the camera at this device node.

offers.label: Retry camera
offers.description: Forgets the chosen camera and asks this device for its cameras again.

offers.label: List cameras
offers.description: Asks this device which cameras it has: the rows the settings page offers, one per camera.

offers.label: Start look
offers.description: Starts the camera's moving picture: the window paints the newest frame as it arrives.

offers.label: Stop look
offers.description: Stops the camera's moving picture, letting the device go.

offers.label: Look
offers.description: Reads the codes the newest frame holds, keeping the first one the scanner view shows.

offers.label: Read codes
offers.description: Decodes the codes in the picture at `url`, keeping the first one the scanner view shows.

offers.label: Shutter
offers.description: The shutter: takes a photo now, starts the self-timer, or records. Space presses it, as a

offers.label: Arm timer
offers.description: Arms the self-timer the person chose, or cancels the one counting down.

offers.label: Capture
offers.description: Takes a photo of the frame the camera shows, and hands it on.

offers.label: Start recording
offers.description: Starts recording from the frames the camera's engine thread takes.

offers.label: Stop recording
offers.description: Stops the clip recording and hands it on once the engine has muxed it.

offers.label: Capture page
offers.description: Captures one page with the chosen scanner and settings.

offers.label: Shutter due
offers.description: The self-timer's moment came: take the photo it counted down to, unless it was cancelled.

offers.label: Copy code
offers.description: Copies what the scanned code says, or its password or link.

offers.label: Keep scan
offers.description: Keeps the scanned code in the history.

offers.label: Set scanner
offers.description: Chooses the scanner the document scans with.

offers.label: Rotate page
offers.description: Turns the selected page a quarter clockwise; its text is read again when the person asks.

offers.label: Recognize text
offers.description: Reads the text off the selected page in the chosen language.

offers.label: Copy text
offers.description: Copies the selected page's recognized text.

offers.label: Move page
offers.description: Moves the selected page one place earlier, or later.

offers.label: Remove page
offers.description: Throws the selected page away.

offers.label: Crop source
offers.description: The selected page's picture, as the crop frame works on it.

offers.label: Crop page
offers.description: Crops the selected page to the part the person kept; its text is read again when they ask.

offers.label: Document pdf
offers.description: The document as one searchable PDF: pages with recognized text carry it, the rest are

offers.label: Open recent
offers.description: Opens the capture that was taken last in the app that owns its bytes.
